##### Project general facts

Lago Vista is a residential community by DAMAC Properties, made up of three towers arranged around a crescent-shaped podium that overlooks the surrounding lakes. The towers hold studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with shops and services set on the podium level.

Residents share a swimming pool, tennis courts, landscaped gardens and a children's play area on the podium, while a gym and a games room are set indoors. The retail units at the base of the towers keep everyday errands close to home.

Apartments come with private balconies, fitted wardrobes and marble-finished kitchens, giving the interiors a practical, easy-to-maintain finish, and many homes look out across the water.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City is a mixed-use community in the south-west of Dubai, set around landscaped lakes and planned for media, printing and creative businesses alongside residential towers. It sits beside Dubai Sports City and Motor City, with Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road running along its edge.

City Centre Me'aisem covers daily shopping, dining and cinema trips, while Dubai Autodrome, the golf course at Dubai Sports City and Arabian Ranches are a short drive away. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects the community to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Village Circle and Al Maktoum International Airport.

Dubai Production City combines freehold residential towers with a business free zone, so rental demand comes both from professionals working in the zone and from tenants looking for value in south-west Dubai. Its podium shops serve a steady local base of residents and office staff.
